cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a weaving studio — a tall wooden loom, shelves of dyed yarn spools, a spinning wheel and a table of woven cloth
cuts.scene: she is an apprentice sitting sideways at the loom clumsily tangling her first thread on the shuttle
cuts.outfit: a weaver look fitted to her body — a fitted linen smock with a short hem over a halter top and shorts, bare shoulders and legs, a single green thread looped on her wrist
